# Vasool — Full Overview

> Vasool is a voice-entry loan collection and lending platform for money lenders, finance companies and NBFCs in India. Built by Thukal. The website is bilingual (English and Tamil, /ta pages). Field staff use an Android/iOS app; the office uses a web dashboard; borrowers get a self-service portal. Works fully offline and syncs when back online.

## What Vasool does

Vasool digitises the daily/weekly/monthly "vasool" (collection) round that lenders traditionally run on paper. A field agent records a payment by speaking — for example "Arun 500 cash" — and it is logged against the right customer automatically, in six languages (English, Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada). The same platform scales from a single-route money lender to a multi-branch NBFC through per-tenant feature flags; each company runs in its own isolated database on infrastructure it controls.

## Loan and finance products

- Daily loans — small loans repaid through daily field collections
- Weekly loans — weekly cycles, with optional custom per-week stepped amounts
- Monthly and semi-monthly loans — for salaried and business borrowers
- EMI loans — equated instalments, 15-day/30-day variants, foreclosure and tenure controls
- Interest-only loans — "kandhu vatti" / "byaj": simple, compound or daily interest, optional weekly cadence
- Gold loans — gold-backed lending with live per-gram rate, valuation and redemption
- Product-based loans — loans tied to physical goods (daily/weekly/monthly/semi-monthly)
- Chit funds (Agent Chit) — groups, members, cycles, foreman commission, late fees, WhatsApp reminders
- Savings schemes (Savings Chit) — festival/deposit schemes with cash or goods maturity payouts
- Gold business — recovered-gold inventory, sales and profit & loss

## Operations and modules

- Voice AI ("Vasool AI") — one recording becomes an app action: create loans, log collections, add customers, call a customer by name, query reports
- AI loan eligibility — aggregates a borrower's history into a risk score with approve/review/reject and a suggested limit
- WhatsApp reminders — server-side sends via the lender's own provider account (Meta, Interakt, Gupshup, WATI, AiSensy)
- Collection & payments — cash and UPI, automatic PDF receipts, payment history, admin cash settlement
- Route management — plan daily/weekly routes, assign to staff, GPS navigation, completion tracking
- Staff tools — live GPS tracking, location history, role-based access control, staff attendance
- Financials — income & expense ledger, day book per route, cash advances, profit & loss reports
- Funding & investors — partner capital (profit-share) and financier borrowings (the liability side)
- Customer management — profiles, KYC document vault (Aadhaar, PAN, voter ID, ration card, gas bill), referee/guarantor linking, live customer location
- Customer self-service portal — borrowers see balances, dues and receipts
- Reporting — dashboards, officer performance, collection summaries, overdue/DPD tracking, P&L

## Security and data ownership

- Each tenant runs in a separate database and storage; no cross-tenant access
- Data lives on infrastructure the client provides or designates — Vasool does not centrally store it
- TLS/SSL in transit, JWT authentication, biometric login, granular role-based access control
- Full audit trail with entity-level change history on every record
- Bot/attack protection and rate limiting
- On the roadmap: formal certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and RBI-aligned compliance modules (CKYC, credit-bureau reporting). Vasool supports a lender's compliance; it does not replace their obligations.

## Deployment

- Multi-tenant: one Docker container + PostgreSQL database per company, behind a shared reverse proxy
- Self-hosting and white-labelling available — run under your own brand on your own servers
- Free plan to get started; standard plan from ₹699/month, custom pricing for multiple loan products
